finding.trigger: Legacy published Rich Text href uses named HTML references that change URL path normalization, for example /p/source/../new
finding.before: The partial hand-written decoder left . and related references encoded, so URL() saw a different path from the browser and the report could produce false broken-link findings or miss same-origin hrefs encoded with :.
finding.after: The report decodes HTML attribute references using entities/decode decodeHTMLAttribute before same-origin and pathname resolution. The exact same-origin, editor-role, redirect, draft exclusion and no-store contracts remain covered.

reuse_review.license: BSD-2-Clause; redistribution notice retained by npm package and lockfile metadata
reuse_review.fit: Established, widely used HTML/XML entity decoder with an HTML attribute decoding API; avoids a hand-maintained partial WHATWG entity table.
reuse_review.tradeoff: Worker dry-run total upload grew from the prior 300.88 KiB to 334.14 KiB (gzip 87.20 KiB); no additional paid service or external runtime request.
